name: ZX_TRX_TAX_DISTRIBUTIONS
description: This table contains the tax distributions information for the external or simulator tax transaction.

columns.name: TAX_DIST_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for a tax distribution.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_CCID
columns.description: Unique combination of segment values that records accounting transactions.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_CLASS
columns.description: Account class from the customer transaction line GL distribution.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_SET_FLAG
columns.description: Yes or No indicates whether the account set for a distribution is stored.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_SOURCE_TAX_RATE_ID
columns.description: Account source tax rate identifier.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_STRING
columns.description: Account string associated with the item distribution line.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_EVENT_ID
columns.description: Identifier for an accounting event record in a table.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Application identifier for a tax distribution.

columns.name: COLLECTED_TAX_CCID
columns.description: Identifier for the account associated with collected tax.

columns.name: COLLECTED_TAX_CONCAT_SEG
columns.description: Code combination used to account for collected tax associated with external transactions.

columns.name: CONTENT_OWNER_ID
columns.description: Party tax profile identifier for a configuration owner of a distribution.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CONVERSION_DATE
columns.description: Date as of which a conversion rate is used to convert an amount into another currency.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CONVERSION_RATE
columns.description: Conversion rate at which the principal unit of one currency can be converted into another currency.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CONVERSION_TYPE
columns.description: Source of a currency conversion rate, such as user defined, spot, or corporate.

columns.name: DEF_SETTLEMENT_OPTION_CODE
columns.description: Default settlement option code.

columns.name: ENTITY_CODE
columns.description: Entity code of the transaction, which indicates the type of transaction being created.

columns.name: EVENT_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Application event class of the transaction.

columns.name: EVENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Event type code for the application event class.

columns.name: FREEZE_FLAG
columns.description: Yes or No indicates whether this tax distribution is frozen.

columns.name: GL_DATE
columns.description: Default accounting date for transactions.

columns.name: GL_POSTED_DATE
columns.description: Date when this distribution was posted in the general ledger.

columns.name: HISTORICAL_FLAG
columns.description: Yes or No indicates whether this tax line is created during migration from prior releases.

columns.name: INCLUSIVE_FLAG
columns.description: Yes or No indicates whether this tax line is inclusive.

columns.name: INTERNAL_ORGANIZATION_ID
columns.description: Internal organization identifier of the tax distribution.

columns.name: LAST_MANUAL_ENTRY
columns.description: Identifier for the column that was last overridden by the user. Possible values are TAX_STATUS, TAX_RATE, TAX_RATE_CODE and TAX_AMOUNT.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Ledger identifier for the self-contained accounting information set for single or multiple legal or management entities.

columns.name: LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Legal entity identifier that is either manually set by user or composed of the country of registration and the registration number of the identifying jurisdiction if automatically generated.

columns.name: LEGAL_REPORTING_STATUS
columns.description: Legal reporting status of the document.

columns.name: MINIMUM_ACCOUNTABLE_UNIT
columns.description: Smallest meaningful denomination of a currency.

columns.name: ORIG_RATE
columns.description: Original tax rate of the distribution.

columns.name: ORIG_RATE_CODE
columns.description: Original tax rate code of the distribution.

columns.name: ORIG_TAX_AMT
columns.description: Tax amount in entered currency before user override.

columns.name: ORIG_TAX_AMT_TAX_CURR
columns.description: Tax amount in tax currency before user override.

columns.name: OVERRIDDEN_FLAG
columns.description: Yes or No indicates whether user has overridden this tax line.

columns.name: POSTED_TO_SLA_FLAG
columns.description: Yes or No indicates whether an item distribution has been posted to SLA.

columns.name: PRECISION
columns.description: One-digit whole number to indicate the decimal place for tax rounding.

columns.name: RECORD_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate whether the record is migrated, seeded or defined by the user.

columns.name: REPORTABLE_FLAG
columns.description: Yes or No indicates whether this tax distribution is reportable.

columns.name: REVENUE_ADJUSTMENT_ID
columns.description: Revenue adjustment identifier of a tax distribution.

columns.name: REVERSE_FLAG
columns.description: Yes or No indicates whether the tax distribution is reversed by another tax distribution.

columns.name: REVERSED_TAX_DIST_ID
columns.description: Reversed Tax Distribution Identifier

columns.name: ROUNDING_RULE_CODE
columns.description: Rule that defines how the rounding should be performed on a value involved in a taxable transaction.

columns.name: TAX
columns.description: Tax code for the classification of a charge imposed by a government through a fiscal or tax authority.

columns.name: TAX_AMT
columns.description: Tax amount associated with the tax distribution.

columns.name: TAX_APPORTIONMENT_LINE_NUMBER
columns.description: Yes or No indicates whether there are multiple tax lines created for the tax of this line during migration from prior releases.

columns.name: TAX_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Unique identification of a currency in which the tax transactions are to be reported.

columns.name: TAX_CURRENCY_CONVERSION_DATE
columns.description: Date of the conversion rate for entered currency to tax currency conversion.

columns.name: TAX_CURRENCY_CONVERSION_RATE
columns.description: Conversion rate for entered currency to tax currency conversion.

columns.name: TAX_CURRENCY_CONVERSION_TYPE
columns.description: Conversion rate type for entered currency to tax currency conversion.

columns.name: TAX_DIST_AMT
columns.description: Monetary value of a tax distribution.

columns.name: TAX_DIST_AMT_FUNCL_CURR
columns.description: Tax distribution amount in ledger currency.

columns.name: TAX_DIST_AMT_TAX_CURR
columns.description: Tax distribution amount in tax currency.

columns.name: TAX_DIST_NUMBER
columns.description: Numeric identifier for a tax distribution.

columns.name: TAX_EVENT_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Application event class of the transaction.

columns.name: TAX_EVENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Tax event type code of the transaction.

columns.name: TAX_ID
columns.description: Tax identifier for the classification of a charge imposed by a government through a fiscal or tax authority.

columns.name: TAX_JURISDICTION_CODE
columns.description: Tax jurisdiction code for a geographic area where a tax is levied by a specific tax authority.

columns.name: TAX_JURISDICTION_ID
columns.description: Tax jurisdiction identifier for a geographic area where a tax is levied by a specific tax authority.

columns.name: TAX_LINE_ID
columns.description: Identifier for a particular tax line in a table.

columns.name: TAX_LINE_NUMBER
columns.description: Line number generated for this tax line.

columns.name: TAX_ONLY_LINE_FLAG
columns.description: Yes or No indicates whether this tax distribution is for a tax only line.

columns.name: TAX_POINT_BASIS
columns.description: Event on which the tax is levied, accounted in the books and reported to the tax authorities.

columns.name: TAX_POINT_DATE
columns.description: Date on which the taxpayer becomes liable for paying the tax to the tax authority.

columns.name: TAX_RATE
columns.description: Rate specified for a tax status for an effective time period. A tax rate can be expressed as a percentage or a value per unit quantity.

columns.name: TAX_RATE_CODE
columns.description: Tax rate code specified for a tax status for an effective time period, expressed as a percentage or a value per unit quantity.

columns.name: TAX_RATE_ID
columns.description: Identifier for the rate specified for a tax status for an effective time period.

columns.name: TAX_REGIME_CODE
columns.description: Tax regime code for the set of tax rules that determines the treatment of one or more taxes administered by a tax authority.

columns.name: TAX_REGIME_ID
columns.description: Tax regime identifier for the set of tax rules that determines the treatment of one or more taxes administered by a tax authority.

columns.name: TAX_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Tax status code for the taxable nature of a product in the context of a transaction for a tax.

columns.name: TAX_STATUS_ID
columns.description: Tax status identifier for the taxable nature of a product in the context of a transaction for a tax.

columns.name: TRX_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Three-letter ISO (International Organization for Standardization) code for the entered currency.

columns.name: TRX_ID
columns.description: System-generated identification number of a transaction.

columns.name: TRX_LEVEL_TYPE
columns.description: Level at which the transaction line identifier is stored. Possible values are LINE, SHIPMENT and FREIGHT.

columns.name: TRX_LINE_DIST_AMT
columns.description: Amount of the current item distribution line.

columns.name: TRX_LINE_DIST_ID
columns.description: Identifier for the current item distribution line.

columns.name: TRX_LINE_DIST_TAX_AMT
columns.description: Tax amount pertaining to the current item distribution.

columns.name: TRX_LINE_ID
columns.description: Identifier for a particular transaction line in a table.

columns.name: TRX_LINE_NUMBER
columns.description: Number of a particular transaction line in a table.

columns.name: TRX_NUMBER
columns.description: Transaction number, typically the number that enables a user to identify a transaction.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: TRANSFERRED_TO_GL_FLAG
columns.description: Column to store posted to GL flag.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Column to store request identifier of the accounting program.

columns.name: CREDIT_ACCOUNT_CCID
columns.description: Credit account identifier for the transaction line.

columns.name: DEBIT_ACCOUNT_CCID
columns.description: Debit account identifier for the transaction line.

columns.name: REPORTING_BATCH_ID
columns.description: To store the selection process batch identifier.

columns.name: TRX_LINE_DIST_AMT_FUNCL_CURR
columns.description: Item distribution amount in ledger currency.
